results.summary: ** Lazy repo corpuses are still accepted when the lazy walk is returned through a helper. - **Category:** Correctness - **Severity:** Major - **Evidence paths:** `ai_router/corpus_scan_guard.py:232-25 ...
results.criterion:
python -c "exec('import importlib.util
import pathlib
import sys
import tempfile
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("guard", "ai_router/corpus_scan_guard.py")
guard = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = guard
spec.loader.exec_module(guard)
source = chr(10).join([
    "from pathlib import Path",
    "ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent",
    "def _sources():",
    "    return ROOT.rglob(\"*.py\")",
    "def test_scan():",
    "    files = _sources()",
    "    assert files",
    "    offenders = [p for p in files if \"bad\" in p.name]",
    "    assert not offenders",
    "",
])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    path = pathlib.Path(d) / "test_lazy_helper.py"
    path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
    raise SystemExit(0 if guard.offenders_in_module(path) else 1)')"
